about_the_game:
Your Granny's retirement fund has been stolen! Do you have what it takes to get it back? Fight through waves of enemies and three unique stages to bring the notorious Hackerguy to justice and get Granny's money back!

Features

Arcade gameplay: play through three different levels with unique challenges and enemies, fighting off 60 waves of enemies. Play in arcade mode to go for the highscore.

Turn-based and real-time: with a hybrid real-time and turn-based combat system, you can plan your moves to execute glorious attacks while still feeling fast-paced and frantic.

Unique weapons: Master 6 unique weapons to take down HackerGuy and his minions. Ambush your enemies, dodge their attacks, and choose the best tool for the job as you switch weapons frantically in this arcade game.

Cartoon story: 4 unique animated cutscenes that will remind you of your favorite cartoons.

and much more!
